q: Have you ever borrowed things from others?
a: Yes. As a child, I often borrowed books from my friends. These days, sometimes I borrow a bicycle from a friend.

q: Would you lend your friends your mobile phone?
a: It would depend on the situation. I would if they need to make an urgent call. But I probably wouldn't if they just need a phone to play games or watch videos.
vocab: 因为紧急的事情打电话

q: How often do you go to the cinema?
a:
I go to the cinema at least once or twice a month. It's a good way to unwind.

或者：
I go to the cinema only a few times a year. I usually watch films on TV or online.
vocab: （电影或电视剧）导演得很好的
（电影或电视剧）表演得很好的

q: What types of films are popular in your country?
a: Comedies are very popular because they make people laugh and help people reduce stress. Sci-fi films are also very popular because they encourage imagination and help people gain knowledge about science.
vocab: 喜剧（情感喜剧叫 romantic comedies）
节奏很快而且有大量动作场景

q: Do you prefer to watch films alone or with friends?
a:
I prefer to watch films alone so that I can concentrate on the films. Watching them with friends can be distracting.

或者：
I prefer watching films with friends. We don't talk during the films, but we enjoy discussing the films after watching them.

q: Do you prefer to watch a film in the cinema or at home?
a:
I prefer to watch a film in the cinema because a cinema screen is much larger than a TV screen and the sound quality in the cinema is better. It also feels special to share the experience of watching a film with many other viewers.

或者：
I prefer to watch a film at home because it's cheaper and more convenient. And I just don't like sitting in a crowded place with many strangers.

q: Would you like to be in a film?
a: No. I'm not good at acting and I would feel nervous in front of a movie camera.
vocab: 表演（“演技”就是 acting skills）

q: Do people in your country like international film stars?
a: Yes, many Hollywood stars and Korean film stars are quite popular in my country. Actually, some of them have appeared in Chinese films.

q: What types of TV shows are popular in your country?
a: Talent shows are very popular these days because they're fun and exciting. TV drama series are also quite popular because they are relaxing.
vocab: 目前，现在（口语中等同 nowadays）

q: Do you like watching cookery programmes on TV?
a:
Yes, I do because they can help me improve my cooking skills. I like watching them also because many TV chefs have a good sense of humour and they teach people to cook healthy meals.

或者：
No, I don't like watching cookery programmes on TV because most of the advice from TV chefs is not practical. Watching their programmes is a waste of time.
vocab: 厨艺节目里的大厨（chef 发音 /ʃef/）
have a good sense of humour
make cooking look like an art form
让做饭看起来像是一种艺术形式
电视上的大厨们给出的建议

q: Do you like watching sports on TV?
a: I enjoy watching team sports, like football and basketball, on TV because it's fun and exciting. But I don't like watching individual sports, such as skiing, on TV.
vocab: 团队运动（反义：individual sport 个人运动）

q: Do you prefer to watch TV alone or with your family?
a:
I prefer to watch TV with my family, especially when there is a TV programme that we all like. It feels great to share the experience as a family and unwind together.

或者：
I prefer to watch TV alone so that I can decide what to watch. Watching TV alone also helps me concentrate on the TV programme.

q: Do you think children should be encouraged to watch TV?
a: It depends on what they watch. I suppose children should be encouraged to watch educational programmes because they can help children gain knowledge about a variety of topics. On the other hand, parents should limit the time that their children spend on entertainment programmes.
vocab: 有知识性的节目（如 National Geographic、Discovery Channel 上的 documentaries 纪录片）
开阔眼界（地道常用短语）
